camera.notes: Full-frame equivalent focal length; use photo for refinement. Camera lies inside assumed envelope behind foreground furniture. Heading refined toward west fireplace wall to place north-west ceiling corner near 58% image width; lens, camera position and elevation retained.

scale.basis: Typical upholstered armchair width 0.78 m (plausible range 0.70–0.90 m); cross-check mantel width about 2.1 m and seat height about 0.45 m. No measured scale is available.

room.basis: Two perpendicular wall planes meet behind the bookcase/lamp. Width 6.4 m and depth 7.2 m provide a plausible envelope around the visible furniture; south and east boundaries are outside the image and not recoverable.

height.basis: Latest portrait correction raises inferred ceiling from 4.05 to 4.22 m to fit top z=3.92 m beneath cornice underside z=3.99 m. Within original plausible 3.6–4.5 m range. Camera and visible window dimensions retained; ceiling-corner projection changes slightly and remains an approximate calibration.

chimney.basis: Visible return to the right of the fireplace establishes a projecting chimney breast. Its width is about 1.25 mantel widths; depth is weakly constrained by the return. Reentry projection correction sets south/north edges to y=1.75/4.52 m, retaining x=0.38 m projection; width becomes 2.77 m and center y=3.135 m. Physical north/south return normals remain +Y/-Y.
chimney.confidence: medium for existence; low for dimensions

fireplace.basis: Mantel estimate is 2.10 m wide and 1.72 m high, with assembly center y=3.185 m. Portrait base 2.02 m leaves 0.30 m above mantel; latest framed height is 1.90 m. Dark firebox is narrower than marble surround; metric dimensions are inferred.
fireplace.confidence: medium for proportions; low for metric size

window.basis: Lace curtains cover a broad opening zone, with orange drapes at left, center and right. Sill is near table height, and head lies below cornice. Two bays are a working partition; frame/mullion locations are concealed and right extent is cropped.
window.confidence: medium for visible opening zone; low for exact bay structure and extent

furniture.basis: Relative placement follows occlusion: sofa foreground; patterned chair before bookcase; rocker in front of window table; red chair behind small round table; orange chair at far right. Sizes use standard chair, sofa, and table proportions. Hidden footprint extents are inferred.
furniture.confidence: medium for ordering; low for exact positions, sizes and rotations

details.basis: Portrait above mantel, two candles, clock, wall sconce, globe, books, lamp, framed photos and statue are visible. Their metric sizes are proportional estimates tied to the scale anchor.
details.confidence: medium for presence; low for dimensions

footstool_correction.basis: Reentry: move from (4.20,5.02) to (3.76,5.65) m, toward the orange armchair and left in camera view. Retain 0.66 x 0.43 x 0.27 m size and -12 degree alignment. Footprint overlaps chair proxy intentionally: stool tucks under the front-left seat edge; downstream must preserve leg clearance. footstool_correction.confidence: medium for relative placement; low for precise depth

rear_furniture_correction.basis: Photographed normalized horizontal centers: bookcase approximately 0.50, globe 0.41, lamp/table 0.61. Retain sizes and camera; solve translations using pinhole projection, west-wall alignment and chair occlusion. Depth remains inferred.
rear_furniture_correction.confidence: medium for horizontal placement and ordering; low for exact depth

foreground_reconciliation.basis: Photograph shows the entire bowl opening on a visible cabinet top in front of the sofa back. Prior S2 bowl extended outside its supporting top and into sofa. Preserve contracted camera and corrected bowl screen center by moving bowl toward camera along its center ray, with physical cabinet top at .95 m. Cabinet and sofa now have parallel, disjoint footprints; cabinet is still lower than 1.00 m sofa crest. Dimensions are a plausible single-view inference, not a measured height.
foreground_reconciliation.confidence: medium for support and ordering; low for exact metric height

Dimensions are reconstruction estimates, not a measured survey.

Window divisions and hidden furniture extents require later visual refinement.
